This package now exports a client extension that integrates with Haneul clients.

```diff
- import { HaneulClient, getFullnodeUrl } from '@haneullabs/haneul/client';
- import { ByeolClient } from '@haneullabs/byeol';
+ import { HaneulGrpcClient } from '@haneullabs/haneul/grpc';
+ import { byeol } from '@haneullabs/byeol';

- const haneulClient = new HaneulClient({ url: getFullnodeUrl('mainnet') });
- const byeolClient = new ByeolClient({
-   client: haneulClient,
-   address: myAddress,
-   env: 'mainnet',
-   balanceManagers: { ... },
- });
+ const client = new HaneulGrpcClient({
+   baseUrl: 'http://158.69.54.239:9000',
+   network: 'mainnet',
+ }).$extend(
+   byeol({
+     address: myAddress,
+     // network is auto-detected from the client
+     balanceManagers: { ... },
+   }),
+ );

- await byeolClient.checkManagerBalance(manager, asset);
+ await client.byeol.checkManagerBalance(manager, asset);
```
